description: A React component for managing application settings, including logging callbacks, alerting configurations, webhook URLs, and callback configurations. It includes UI elements for adding, editing, deleting callbacks, and configuring alerting options.

classes.name: SettingsPageProps
classes.description: Props interface for the Settings React component, including access token, user role, user ID, and premium user status.

classes.name: genericCallbackParams
classes.description: Interface defining callback parameter structure with callback names and parameters.

classes.name: DynamicParamsFields
classes.description: React functional component rendering dynamic input fields based on callback parameters and configurations.

classes.name: CallbackSelector
classes.description: React functional component rendering a dropdown to select callback configurations.

methods.name: getDynamicParamsForCallback
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve dynamic parameters for a given callback from callback configurations.

methods.name: buildCallbackPayload
methods.description: Helper function to construct payload object for callback API requests based on form values.

methods.name: handleCallbackSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of callback form data, updating or adding callbacks via API.

methods.name: updateCallbackCall
methods.description: Function to trigger callback update process with current form data.

methods.name: addNewCallbackCall
methods.description: Function to add a new callback based on form data.

methods.name: handleSelectedCallbackChange
methods.description: Updates state when a different callback is selected, fetching its parameters.

methods.name: handleSaveAlerts
methods.description: Saves alert configuration and webhook URLs.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves environment variable changes for a callback.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Handles the confirmation of adding a new callback, constructing payloads based on selected callback type.

methods.name: handleDeleteCallback
methods.description: Prepares to delete a callback, opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDeleteCallback
methods.description: Confirms and executes callback deletion via API.
